'''Corpse carrier''' is a monster spawned after the western crystal is destroyed by [[Taraket the Necromancer]] during the battle with him. 

It uses melee attacks and periodically summons a mix of three [[summoned skeleton]]s and [[summoned skeleton archer]]s.

==Achievements==
* {{Achievement|Sinister Crystal}}
* {{Achievement|Tank and Spank}}
